#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    int tc = 1;
    for (int i = 0; i < tc; i++) {
        int N;
        cin >> N;
        string line;
        cin >> line;
        vector<char> S(line.begin(), line.end());

        int maxLen = 0, wordsInPar = 0, count = 0, parFlag = 0;
        for (char c : S) {
            if (c == '_') {
                if (parFlag == 0) {
                    maxLen = max(maxLen, count);
                } else if (count > 0) {
                    wordsInPar++;
                }
                count = 0;
            } else if (c == '(') {
                parFlag = 1;
                maxLen = max(maxLen, count);
                count = 0;
            } else if (c == ')') {
                parFlag = 0;
                if (count > 0) {
                    wordsInPar++;
                }
                count = 0;
            } else {
                count++;
            }
            if (parFlag == 0) {
                maxLen = max(maxLen, count);
            }
        }
        cout << maxLen << " " << wordsInPar << "\n";
    }
    return 0;
}
